subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should the shared public resolver permanently expose defaults, environment injection, provider normalization, and unavailable-ref notification while Ollama fails closed for unavailable configured SecretRefs?
rationale: Source and live proof establish correctness, but repository policy treats public Plugin SDK expansion and removal of a reachable credential fallback as intentional compatibility decisions requiring owner confirmation.

options.title: Accept unified contract
options.body: Approve the four public hooks and fail-closed Ollama behavior because they prevent silent credential switching and remove duplicated provider policy.

options.title: Narrow public exposure
options.body: Keep the Ollama fix while internalizing resolver customization that should not become external plugin contract.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Retain the previous fallback for unavailable configured refs, accepting that a different ambient credential may be used.

recommendation.title: Accept unified contract
recommendation.body: Approve the four public hooks and fail-closed Ollama behavior because they prevent silent credential switching and remove duplicated provider policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced the current helper, public export, and Ollama credential path in the same recent commit.
